name: Farming Simulator 25 Dedicated Server
description: Adopt an existing Farming Simulator 25 installation and manage its Windows dedicated-server launcher directly.
known_limitations: Farming Simulator 25 must already be installed and activated; GameNode does not download, update, or activate the game.

The dedicatedServer.exe launcher owns Farming Simulator's web administration and game-server process. GameNode manages the launcher process and does not provide a web-panel or child-process integration.
dedicatedServer.xml and the generated save/mod data remain managed by Farming Simulator; GameNode does not rewrite this XML through a generic adapter.
The documented default multiplayer ports are registered as fixed UDP ports. If dedicatedServer.xml uses different ports, update the server's port registrations manually.
A separate Farming Simulator license/account is required for a dedicated server; the Steam version may also require steam_appid.txt containing 2300320.

config_files.description: Farming Simulator dedicated-server and web-administration settings; managed by the game.

requirements.description: The reviewed dedicated-server workflow targets Windows.
The reviewed dedicated-server executable is a 64-bit Windows application.
A separate Farming Simulator 25 license/account is required for the dedicated server.

help.summary: GameNode verifies an existing Farming Simulator 25 installation and launches dedicatedServer.exe directly without a shell.
notes: Select the Farming Simulator 25 installation directory, not the parent Steam or GIANTS directory.
Configure the initial admin account and server settings in dedicatedServer.xml or Farming Simulator's dedicated-server web administration before starting the game server.
The default multiplayer ports are UDP 10823, 10824, and 10825. The web-administration ports are configured separately by Farming Simulator and are not exposed as GameNode ports.

findings.summary: Farming Simulator's dedicatedServer.exe controls the web administration and game-server process; GameNode manages the launcher process only.
dedicatedServer.xml and generated game data remain managed by Farming Simulator rather than a GameNode configuration adapter.
